notes:
v0.8.0-rc.4: Config backup / restore — milestone release.

This release wraps the v0.6.46 → v0.6.49 sequence of
incremental fixes into a single milestone. Backup and
restore of the g90 box's whitelisted config is now a
first-class feature of the launcher, with a standalone
shell-script path for boxes that can't run the
launcher (e.g. g90f1r2 on ECG_Guest wifi).

What's new in v0.8.0-rc.4:

1. Launcher's /backup-configs and /restore-configs
   routes (v0.6.46).

   - GET /backup-configs: download a tar.gz of the
     live box's whitelisted config. A copy is also
     kept on the box at
     /home/pi/shared_launcher/backups/, rotated to
     the last 5 archives.
   - GET /restore-configs: upload form, plus a list
     of the last 5 on-box archives (no need to
     download + re-upload).
   - POST /restore-configs/preview: extract to a
     staging dir, diff against live files, render
     a table showing add/replace/skip per file,
     plus a confirm button.
   - POST /restore-configs/apply/<token>: copy
     staged files to live paths, wipe the staging
     dir, restart affected services.
   - POST /restore-configs/cancel/<token>: wipe
     staging, return to upload form.

   Whitelist (closed, 15 entries): Reticulum config,
   ReticulumHF config.env, pat, modem73, ardopc,
   direwolf, js8call, fldigi, flrig, wsjtx, hamlib,
   pavucontrol.ini, hostapd, dhcp, patmenu2. The
   whitelist is identical between the launcher and
   the shell scripts.

   Box-specific (per op 21:38 MDT): captures
   include the box's Reticulum identity. Restoring
   to a different box gives the new box the old
   box's identity on the mesh.

   Replace-all restore (per op 21:40 MDT) with
   dry-run preview.
   Rotate last 5 (per op 21:40 MDT).

2. Standalone shell scripts (v0.6.49) for boxes
   that can't run the launcher.

   - scripts/capture-config.sh: capture the live
     box's whitelisted config. No dependencies
     beyond bash + tar + standard coreutils.
   - scripts/restore-config.sh: two-step
     (preview + apply) restore. Whitelist-validated
     (rejects tarballs with non-whitelisted paths,
     as a path-traversal guard). Sudo fallback for
     root-owned files (e.g. pat config.json).
   - scripts/box-backup-flow.sh: convenience
     wrapper for ssh+scp from m5boss. Run as
       bash box-backup-flow.sh <src>
       bash box-backup-flow.sh <src> --send <dst>

   The tarball format is identical to the
   launcher's /backup-configs output: gzipped,
   paths without leading /, fixed archive mtime.
   Tarballs are interchangeable between the
   launcher and the shell scripts.

3. Bootstrap hardening (v0.6.44, v0.6.47): the
   reticulumpi-bootstrap.sh is now resilient to
   partial runs. The for-loop that copies systemd
   units uses || true; the modem73 settings install
   mkdir -p's the parent dir before installing.
   A mid-bootstrap crash (e.g. on apt + 10 min
   network install) no longer leaves the box
   with only the units that happened to make it
   to /etc/systemd/system/.

4. Operator-facing addition: the launcher index
   page has Backup and Restore links in the
   version row, alongside Update and Check
   Components.

End-to-end tested:

  - On m5boss (dev box): full Flask test client
    cycle (upload → preview → apply → file written,
    staging wiped, 410 Gone on bad token).
  - On g90test (live dev box, v0.6.13 → v0.6.49):
    shell scripts run against the live box
    without the launcher, capture 6 paths
    included / 9 skipped, restore --apply
    writes 7 files (5 direct, 2 via sudo fallback
    for root-owned files).
  - Whitelist safety: a tarball containing
    /etc/passwd is rejected before extraction
    with a clear error message.

Files added in v0.8.0-rc.4:

  scripts/config_backup.py      (~400 lines, helper module)
  scripts/capture-config.sh     (~7 KB, standalone capture)
  scripts/restore-config.sh     (~10 KB, standalone restore)
  scripts/box-backup-flow.sh    (~2 KB, ssh+scp wrapper)

Net diff since v0.6.43: ~1100 lines added, ~30 lines
modified. The launcher grew from 1467 lines to ~1700
lines, with 6 new routes.

Operator usage (g90f1r2, can't reach the launcher):

  # On a machine that can reach f1r2 (e.g. laptop
  # on ECG_Guest):
  scp https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smeshT/reticulumpi/main/scripts/capture-config.sh pi@g90f1r2.local:/tmp/
  ssh pi@g90f1r2.local 'bash /tmp/capture-config.sh'
  scp pi@g90f1r2.local:/home/pi/g90-configs-g90f1r2-*.tar.gz .
  # Then either:
  #   - upload to a launcher-equipped box's /restore-configs
  #   - scp to a freshly-flashed box and:
  bash restore-config.sh <tarball> --apply --yes

Operator usage (g90digi, can reach the launcher):

  # From any browser on the same LAN/ZT as the box:
  http://g90digi.local/backup-configs
    -> downloads g90-configs-g90digi-<ver>-<ts>.tar.gz
    -> also persists a copy to
       /home/pi/shared_launcher/backups/ (rotated to last 5)

  # To restore on the same box (e.g. after a config
  # edit went wrong) or to a different box:
  http://<box>/restore-configs
    -> upload the tarball
    -> preview the diff
    -> click Apply
milestone_summary: Config backup / restore is a first-class feature of the launcher. Standalone shell scripts cover boxes that can't run the launcher (g90f1r2 on ECG_Guest wifi). Bootstrap hardened to recover from partial runs. 11 incremental releases in the v0.6.4x series tested and shipped since v0.6.43.
